environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed in hardened pod with securityContext dropping CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Container runs as non-root (uid 1000). Additionally, an Istio AuthorizationPolicy with custom Wasm plugin performs request-time validation: the plugin intercepts outbound 3xx responses on the /oauth/callback path and validates that the Location header's resolved IP (after DNS lookup within the mesh) does not point to an external address unless it matches entries in a ConfigMap-backed allowlist (oauth-redirect-allowlist). The Wasm plugin uses the proxy_dns_resolve hostcall to resolve the redirect target at response time, preventing DNS rebinding. The allowlist ConfigMap contains only 'app.example.com' and 'www.example.com' with their pinned IPs (10.0.5.12, 10.0.5.13). Egress is further restricted by a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allowing only port 443 to the IdP CIDR (203.0.113.0/24) and internal cluster DNS.

config.wasm_plugin: oauth-redirect-guard v1.2.0 - intercepts 3xx on /oauth/callback, resolves Location header via proxy_dns_resolve, blocks if resolved IP not in allowlist ConfigMap
